content.text: In this heartfelt video, Judge Frank Caprio shares his thoughts on the importance of siblings and the special bond they create in our lives. On National Siblings Day, he reflects on the memories, support, laughter, and love that only brothers and sisters can bring. From childhood to adulthood, siblings walk through life with us — as our first friends, our fiercest protectors, and our most loyal companions. Join Judge Caprio in celebrating the joy and meaning of family connections, and let this video be your reminder to reach out to a sibling today and say, "I'm grateful for you." 💬 “The love of a sibling is one of life’s greatest gifts.” – Judge Frank Caprio Please visit my website to get more information: https://www.frankcaprio.com/ ✨ Support families in need by contributing to the Filomena Fund—learn more at https://rifoundation.org/funds/filomena-fund 📚 Order my new book, “Compassion in the Court”, for inspiring stories of justice and kindness!
